title: Echo External Reference Research Loop
objective: Continuously research external canon, re-evaluate all lyrics and connections, measure quality, and plan Reference Card art without automatic canon promotion.

steps.action: Split song-level deficits into clue-sized research jobs.
Claim a bounded batch with runner identity and lease.
Retrieve primary or authoritative sources and separate source facts from lyric inference.
Validate source URLs, exact lyric lines, plurality, shared-language channels, and authority boundaries.
Create or enrich a non-canon Reference Card proposal.
Scan every lyric and existing connection with new signals; hold ambiguous short-name matches.
Re-run sharpening and compare coverage, deltas, bridges, ambiguity, provenance, and safety.
Plan GPT Image jobs only for validated, public, nonprivate source references.
Use the projected run as the next cycle input.
